el.¿Qué es el Instructorado en Yoga Esencia: What is the Instructorado en Yoga Esencial?
el.Es una formación anual de Yoga de seis m: It's a six-month yearly Yoga training, online and live, covering the history and philosophy of Yoga, the chakra system, asanas, pranayamas, meditation, and the pedagogy of teaching a class.
el.No. Se empieza desde cero. Alcanza con t: No. You start from scratch. All you need is a practice of your own and a desire to study.

el.De marzo a agosto de 2027, los martes de: From March to August 2027, on Tuesdays from 19:00 to 21:00, Argentina time. It runs for six months, with one topic per month.
el.¿Es online o presencial?: Is it online or in person?
el.La cursada es online, en vivo por Zoom,: The course is online, live on Zoom, and every class is recorded. At the end there is an optional in-person gathering in Buenos Aires: if you can't travel, it is replaced by a personalized online supervision.
